numbers.label: Verses (ayahs)

numbers.label: Words (QAC v0.4)
numbers.rule: One QAC word = one (surah, verse, word) location; a multi-segment word counts once

numbers.label: Segments (QAC v0.4)
numbers.rule: One QAC data line = one segment (prefix, stem or suffix)

numbers.label: Unique surface forms
numbers.rule: Distinct whitespace-separated tokens in the Tanzil Uthmani text as printed (diacritics kept), 6,236 verse lines incl. the 112 unnumbered basmalahs; excl. basmalahs 18,993

numbers.label: Unique stems (QAC v0.4)
numbers.rule: Distinct FORM values on STEM segments in QAC v0.4 (Buckwalter transliteration)

numbers.label: Unique roots (QAC v0.4)
numbers.rule: Distinct ROOT: values in QAC v0.4

numbers.label: Unique lemmas (QAC v0.4)
numbers.rule: Distinct LEM: values in QAC v0.4

numbers.label: Letters (excl. unnumbered basmalahs)
numbers.rule: HEADLINE letter figure. Base letters only on the Tanzil Uthmani text; diacritics/tashkil excluded, shaddah counts its letter once, hamza forms count as letters, alef wasla counts, dagger alif / small waw / small yeh are marks, not letters; the 112 unnumbered basmalahs (19 letters each) excluded

numbers.label: Letters (incl. unnumbered basmalahs)
numbers.rule: Same letter rule as the headline figure, but with the 112 unnumbered basmalahs as printed in the Tanzil text included (+2,128 letters)

numbers.label: Letters, classical total (Ibn Abbas report)
numbers.rule: Classical report, NOT a script count: Ibn Abbas via al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran (1/231). Reproduces under no rule tried (325,386 excl. / 327,514 incl.); classical authorities disagree among themselves (Basra 323,015; Mujahid 321,000; Ibn Mas'ud 300,670; Salam Abu Muhammad 340,740). Shown for comparison only.
numbers.source: al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran 1/231 (Ibn Abbas report); cf. SeekersGuidance, Shaykh Anas al-Musa

numbers.label: Letters in the Basmalah
numbers.rule: Letter count of Quran 1:1 under the project letter rule (alef wasla counts)

numbers.label: Basmalah occurrences
numbers.rule: 113 surah openings (every surah except At-Tawbah, 9) + the Basmalah inside verse 27:30; counted on the Tanzil text

numbers.label: Tanzil whitespace tokens (incl. basmalahs)
numbers.rule: Whitespace-separated tokens over the 6,236 Tanzil verse lines as printed; 452 more than QAC words (448 basmalah words + 4 segmentation differences)

numbers.label: Tanzil whitespace tokens (excl. basmalahs)
numbers.rule: Whitespace-separated tokens over the 6,236 Tanzil verse lines with the 112 unnumbered basmalahs (4 words each) removed; 4 more than QAC words (segmentation differences)
